login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: Two-step sign-in is on for this account. Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows now, or one of your recovery codes.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.required: Admins must use two-step sign-in. Until you set it up, admin pages are hidden.
twoStep.intro: After your password, you will also enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis). Someone who learns your password still cannot sign in.
twoStep.scan: 1. In your authenticator app, add an account and scan this code.
twoStep.manual: If you cannot scan, type this key instead:
twoStep.qrAlt: QR code to add Lokdhara to an authenticator app
twoStep.codeLabel: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now
twoStep.codesIntro: Write these recovery codes on paper and keep them safe. Each works once, if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
twoStep.alreadyOn: Two-step sign-in is on for your account. If you lose your phone and your recovery codes, ask the server maintainer to reset it.

consent.title: Consent for {{code}}
consent.testForm: Test form: do not use it to record anyone for real.
consent.defaultNo: Each question is answered separately. Every answer starts as No.
consent.storeRequired: Without permission to keep and review the recording, nothing can be recorded.

questions.allow_store_and_review: May we keep the recording safely and let trained reviewers listen to it and check the writing?
questions.allow_research: May approved researchers study it for language research?
questions.allow_public_access: May anyone on the internet listen to or read it in future?
questions.allow_ai_training: May it be used to build computer tools, such as speech recognition for Mundari?
questions.allow_commercial_use: May companies use it in products they sell?
questions.demographics_consented: May we record age group, home area, and languages spoken?
questions.attribution: How should the speaker be credited?

attribution.pseudonymous: A code instead of the name
attribution.name: By name

method.in_app: The speaker confirmed on this screen

consent.oralHint: Record the speaker answering the questions aloud. This recording is kept separately and is never part of the collection.

minor.hint: A parent or guardian must read this form and agree together with them.
minor.relationship: Who is the parent or guardian? (for example: mother)

record.noMicrophone: The microphone could not be used. Allow microphone access, or choose a file instead.
record.tooShort: That was shorter than a second. Please record again.
record.ready: Recording ready. Listen to check it.

prompt.typeLegend: What should the speaker respond to?
prompt.scriptLegend: Which script should the sentence be in?

text.hint: Write exactly as you would. There is no single correct spelling.
text.transcriptionHint: Optional: write down what is said in the recording, as you hear it.
text.scriptMismatch: This text does not seem to be in {{script}}. If you meant another script, choose it above; otherwise you can keep it as it is.

details.contentType: What kind of content is it?
details.title: Title (optional)
details.regionHint: A district or block is enough, never a village or address.
details.speakerCount: How many people speak in it?
details.notesHint: Do not write names or contact details here.

status.submissions: {{sent}} sent, {{accepted}} accepted, {{rejected}} rejected by the checks

archive.title: Download everything
archive.intro: One zip of all the data: every original recording, all texts, speakers' names and contacts, consent records, and items that are restricted, hidden or waiting for withdrawal. Nothing is filtered. Keep it private and encrypted, and delete a speaker's data from it if they withdraw.
archive.reason: Why do you need it? (kept in the audit log; no names)
archive.needsReason: Write a reason of at least 10 characters to download.

jobs.title: Failed checks
jobs.intro: Checks that stopped after their last attempt. Fix the cause first, then run them again. The original recording is never changed.
jobs.adminOnly: Only admins can see this page.

submission.notReadyToPlay: The recording is still being prepared for listening.
submission.unverified: Written by the contributor, not checked by anyone
submission.sourceChanged: The text this translates has changed since. Please check the translation.
submission.scriptMismatch: This text does not use the script chosen for it ({{script}}). Check that the right script was picked.
submission.hidden: Hidden by an admin after a report: {{reasons}}. Researchers no longer see it.

rejected.title: This file could not be used
rejected.keptNothing: The recording was not kept. You can record it again, or choose a different file.

reasons.unreadable: The file could not be opened as a sound recording.
reasons.video_stream: The file is a video. Please send only the sound.
reasons.no_audio_stream: The file has no sound in it.
reasons.several_audio_streams: The file has more than one sound track.
reasons.codec_not_accepted: This kind of audio file is not accepted.
reasons.too_many_channels: The recording has too many sound channels.
reasons.sample_rate: The recording was saved with a sound quality setting the platform does not accept.
reasons.decode_errors: The file is damaged. It may have been cut off while saving or sending.
reasons.no_audio_decoded: The file has no sound that can be played.
reasons.too_long: The recording is too long. Please record it in shorter parts.
reasons.other: The checks could not use this file.

reasons.third_party_voice: Someone else can be heard who did not agree

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Accepted recordings and texts whose speakers agreed to research use. Texts are written by contributors and not checked by anyone.
catalogue.notAllowed: Only researchers and admins can see the catalogue.
catalogue.search: Words in the title or text

qualityFlags.possible_duplicate: may be a copy of another recording

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Items someone reported. Listen or read first, then hide the item or dismiss the reports. Write down why: the reason is kept.

releases.title: Dataset releases
releases.intro: A release is a fixed selection of accepted items for one purpose. Only items whose speakers agreed to that use are taken; hidden items never are. Once frozen, a release never changes.
releases.slugHint: Small letters, numbers and dashes, for example mundari-speech-pilot.
releases.dataCard: Data card: what this release is for and what to know about it
releases.leftOut_one: {{count}} accepted item is left out because of consent or a hidden flag.
releases.leftOut_other: {{count}} accepted items are left out because of consent or a hidden flag.
releases.checksIntro: Checks D1 to D9 look at consent, files, texts and fields again before freezing.
releases.freezeIntro: Freezing records exactly which items, texts and files are in this release. It cannot be undone; only retracted.
releases.retractIntro: Retract a release that must no longer be used, for example after a consent problem. Its packages are deleted; the record stays.
releases.withdrawn_one: {{count}} item of this release was taken back by its speaker, or its speaker no longer allows this use. The release can no longer be exported. Start a replacement release without it.
releases.withdrawn_other: {{count}} items of this release were taken back by their speakers, or their speakers no longer allow this use. The release can no longer be exported. Start a replacement release without them.
releases.patchDraft: This draft replaces a frozen release. It can only take items of that release, so items that were taken back stay out.

exports.title: Export requests
exports.intro: Ask for a package of a frozen release and say what it is for. An admin decides; that can be you. A ready package can be downloaded for a few days, then it is deleted.
exports.purposeStatement: What will you use it for?
exports.requested: Request sent. An admin will decide.

withdrawal.title: Taking recordings back
withdrawal.intro: You can take back one item you sent, or everything of a person you record for. An admin checks that the request really comes from that person. Then the items are hidden at once and their recordings and texts are deleted.
withdrawal.fullIntro: This takes back every item, and no new recordings can be made for this person. Their details are deleted too. It cannot be undone.
withdrawal.changeConsent: Or keep the recordings and change what they may be used for
withdrawal.itemIntro: If you no longer want this item in Lokdhara, ask for it to be taken back. An admin checks the request first.
withdrawal.copies: Copies that researchers already downloaded cannot be deleted from here, but no new copies are given out. Backups of the server keep it for up to a year before it is gone everywhere.
withdrawal.sent: Request sent. An admin will check it.

adminWithdrawals.title: Withdrawal requests
adminWithdrawals.intro: Requests to take recordings back. First make sure the request really comes from the speaker or someone who may speak for them. Accepting hides the items at once and deletes their recordings and texts; it cannot be undone. Frozen releases with these items can no longer be exported.
adminWithdrawals.logIntro: For a request that came by phone, in person, by email or through a facilitator.
adminWithdrawals.speaker: Speaker
adminWithdrawals.submissionId: Item number (from the address of the item's page)
adminWithdrawals.narrowFirst: For fewer uses, record the speaker's new answers first, then accept here:
adminWithdrawals.checkNote: How you checked who asked, or why you refuse
adminWithdrawals.closeNote: How you told the person it is done
adminWithdrawals.verifyConfirm: This hides the items at once and deletes their recordings and texts for good. Continue?

keyboard.label: Devanagari keyboard
keyboard.romanHint: Examples: naam → नाम, kitaab → किताब. Capitals for ट ठ ड ढ ण ष (T, Th, D, Dh, N, Sh), M for ं, .n for ँ. Type a between letters to keep them apart.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Anyone can join Lokdhara to share Mundari speech and text. You need no email or phone number.
signup.displayName: Your name as others see it
signup.usernameHint: 3 to 40 letters or numbers; you use it to sign in. Write it down.
signup.passwordHint_one: At least {{count}} character, and not your username.
signup.passwordHint_other: At least {{count}} characters, and not your username.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.intro: Choose a username and password for your new account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password is changed. You are signed out on every phone and computer.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Ask your coordinator or the Lokdhara team. After checking that the account is yours, they send you a link to choose a new password. The link works once.
forgot.username: Tell them your username. They never need your old password.

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: You fill this in once. Every recording you make for yourself uses it, and you can change it here any time.
profile.privateHint: Only you and the project admins can see these. They are stored encrypted and never put in datasets.
profile.contactHint: Only used to contact you about your recordings.
profile.reusedHint: Filled in for each new recording; you can change it there.
profile.noDemographics: You chose not to share your age group, area and languages, so they are not asked.

users.title: People and accounts
users.forgotIntro: First make sure the request really comes from the account owner, for example in person or through their facilitator. Then find the account and make a reset link.
users.confirmReset: Make a password reset link for {{username}}? Anyone with the link can set a new password.
users.linkOnce: Copy this link now and send it only to this person. It is shown once and works once.
users.inviteIntro: Anyone can sign up as a contributor. Facilitators, reviewers, researchers and admins join through an invitation link.
